# Lucide 1.57.0

Source: https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide/tree/1.57.0/icons
License: ISC, with MIT notices for Feather-derived icons (see LICENSE).

Only the icons in the shared catalogue are included. Their child SVG elements preserve the original geometry and attributes; whitespace between elements is removed
in `crates/web/templates/icon-lucide-*.html`; `ui::icon` provides the common SVG
root with decorative accessibility attributes, explicit size and currentColor.
No scripts, remote resources, user-provided markup or runtime dependencies.
To update, review the upstream tag and license, replace the child elements,
and update this version and the source checksums together.
